questions.q: When planning a living room layout, what is the standard recommended distance between a coffee table and the sofa?
questions.n: This distance allows for enough legroom while keeping the table within easy reach of seated individuals.

questions.q: For a simple passage between low objects, such as a sofa and a coffee table, what is the minimum required clearance?
questions.n: A 40 cm clearance is sufficient for a person to navigate between low-profile furniture items.

questions.q: In a dining area, what is the acceptable minimum width for a single place setting to ensure basic freedom of movement?
questions.n: 50 cm represents the absolute minimum acceptable width for a person at a dining table.

questions.q: What is the standard width of a double bed according to Fajardo's planning standards?
questions.n: The standard double bed (or full-size) is typically 1.35 meters wide.

questions.q: To provide ample space for a dining table, what is the minimum clearance required from the edge of the table to allow for a chair plus access and passage?
questions.n: 95 cm provides enough space for the seated person and a clear way for another person to pass behind them.

questions.q: In kitchen design, what is the standard recommended maximum height for the countertop?
questions.n: 0.90 meters (approx. 36 inches) is the ergonomic standard for comfortable kitchen work.

questions.q: Which type of bath arrangement is designed to provide greater privacy by separating the tub and shower from the toilet using a partition?
questions.n: This layout uses partitions to allow multiple functions of the bathroom to be used simultaneously with privacy.

questions.q: What is the recommended length of a dining table intended to seat 8 persons comfortably?
questions.n: A 2.70-meter table allows for approximately three people on each side and one at each end.

questions.q: What is the standard depth of a clothes closet in a bedroom, assuming no hook strip is included?
questions.n: 60 cm (approx. 24 inches) is the standard depth required to accommodate hangers.

questions.q: For a general traffic lane in a residential setting, what is the minimum recommended pathway clearance?
questions.n: 100 cm (1 meter) is the standard for a major traffic lane to ensure two people can pass or one can move freely.

questions.q: What is the standard height of a console table?
questions.n: Console tables are typically taller than desks to allow for decorative use in hallways or behind sofas.

questions.q: What is the standard length of a small desk?

questions.q: What is the distance between an armchair and an ottoman?

questions.q: When placing an armchair with a coffee table near a wall, what is the required distance to the wall?
questions.n: This provides enough space to prevent the furniture from feeling jammed against the wall.

questions.q: What is the total length range for a sofa accompanied by two end tables?

questions.q: For passage between high objects (hip height or over), what is the minimum required clearance?

questions.n: 90 cm provides enough space for a person to walk past without disturbing the seated individual.

questions.q: What is the 'preferred' clearance for an adequate traffic lane between a main entrance and a major seating group?
questions.n: A 130 cm clearance is preferred to ensure smooth flow and a sense of openness in high-traffic entry areas.

questions.q: In a dining area, what is the adequate minimum width for a single place setting?
questions.n: 60 cm is considered the 'adequate' standard for a person to dine without feeling too restricted.

questions.q: For 'comfort seating' at a table, what is the required space dimension per table perimeter per person?
questions.n: 60 cm provides the necessary perimeter for a comfortable, uncrowded dining experience.

questions.q: When a dining table is placed in a kitchen, what is the minimum clearance required from the table edge to the base cabinets?
questions.n: 120 cm is required to ensure both the dining area and the kitchen workspace remain functional simultaneously.
